status: ②a で宣言。②a の技術受理の後、②b で、この組を変えずに一度だけ走らせる。③はこの組を引き継いで変えない

evaluation.population: all 80 bodies (40 individuals x 2 rule_c values); no exclusion
evaluation.criterion_1: fraction of bodies with decided / windows >= q is strictly greater than 1/2
evaluation.criterion_2: fraction of bodies with A1_occurred and A2_occurred is strictly greater than 1/2

forbidden_outputs: per-body or pooled counts of A1 and of A2 separately
any proportion of A1 (or A2) among decided windows
any change over windows or time
any difference between the rule_c = A1 and rule_c = A2 bodies
audit_records: layer A: I2 decider records per body
layer B: world intent records per body (delta_id, source_id, created_pulse, action)
